about_the_game:
Description:

With our Multi Clothes plugin, you'll be able to enhance your game experience by allowing players to choose between different Skins for your characters! (It allows you to change the Character, Face, and Sv_Actor graphics). Additionally, you can set it so that when a character wears a specific outfit, a switch is activated—for example, imagine you have an outfit that transforms you into a cat form and lets you go through a hole you normally wouldn’t fit through. Imagination is the limit!

Compatible with the default graphics and sizes of RPG Maker MZ!

Key Features:- Seamless Outfit Changes: Swap outfits for your characters on the fly during gameplay.

- Graphical Flexibility: Customize character graphics, faces, and battlers for each outfit.

- Immersive Sound Effects: Add captivating sound effects when changing outfits for that extra cinematic touch.

- Convenient Wardrobe Menu: Access the wardrobe menu effortlessly from your main menu screen.

- Switch Integration: Unlock outfits dynamically using in-game switches.

What's in this package?Attached is a compressed file containing:

  - The Multi Clothes plugin file: "MultiClothes.js":
Including all versions released to date.
(May include "Release" and "Alternative" versions)

- The "Plugin Support" folder contains an HTML file that, when run, will display more information about the plugin. (Plugin demonstration video, support links*, among other things)
* Important: Support is only available in English and Spanish.

- The plugin documentation is included within the plugin itself; you can read it through the RPG MAKER MZ Plugin Editor (Only available in English)

If you have questions about other topics, please visit our support page for more information.

----------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
